name: ContextMenu
intent: Right-click (context) menu of actions scoped to the element it wraps. Items highlight on pointer or keyboard focus using the --menu-highlight token and carry a pointer cursor.
when: Right-click actions on rows, cards, or canvas items
Desktop power-user shortcuts on a target

chooseOver.because: Same menu UI, but DropdownMenu uses an explicit trigger while ContextMenu uses right-click on the wrapped element

commonMistakes.mistake: Rely on it as the only, discoverable action surface
commonMistakes.avoidOverride: Rely on it as the only, discoverable action surface — also expose a visible DropdownMenu

usage: Use ContextMenu to help users navigate through your application or content hierarchy. This component provides clear wayfinding and helps users understand their current location within the interface.

ContextMenu is ideal for multi-page applications, content-heavy interfaces, or any situation where users need to move between different sections. Keep navigation patterns consistent across your application for better user experience.
